title: CAS-07080 — Today with David McCullagh — RTÉ Radio 1
text:
Programme: Today with David McCullagh
Broadcast / VOD service: RTÉ Radio 1
Date broadcast or accessed: 23.01.2026
Statute and/or regulatory code: Code of Fairness, Objectivity & Impartiality in News and Current Affairs: Obligation 14.3.Code of Programme Standards: Obligations 17.1
Short description: The complaint is about a discussion on legislation that will deal with the recognition of parentage and citizenship for children born via surrogates. The complaint alleges that the absence of legal context regarding commercial surrogacy risked giving listeners the impression that commercial surrogacy remains an available, acceptable or lawful pathway for Irish residents.
Outcome: Dismissed
Commission Decision: Dismiss the complaint pursuant to section 48(4)(a) of the Broadcasting Act 2009, as amended.
Commission Decision Date: 23.04.2026
